name: Sacred Flame

targets.description: One creature you can see within range.

summary: Dex save or 1d8 Radiant damage; Half and Three-Quarters Cover don't help the save.
text: One creature you can see within range makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d8 Radiant damage on a failure. Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover give it no benefit on this save. The damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
